notes: Equivalent to a known open problem. sigma_e(p) = p, so p || n e-perfect implies n/p e-perfect. With Straus-Subbarao 1974 (no odd e-perfect): 4 | n always. 9 | n always iff no e-perfect number is coprime to 3 (open; Fabrykowski-Subbarao 1986: such n > 10^664; listed open by Lelechenko arXiv:1405.7597). b-file 10000 terms all divisible by 36. Outside Lean: everything (hand reduction + cited theorems).

sources.cite: E. G. Straus, M. V. Subbarao, On exponential divisors, Duke Math. J. 41 (1974) 465-471
J. Fabrykowski, M. V. Subbarao, On e-perfect numbers not divisible by 3, Nieuw Arch. Wisk. (4) 4 (1986) 165-173
A. V. Lelechenko, Exponential and infinitary divisors, arXiv:1405.7597

prior_art.note: The 4 | n half follows from Straus-Subbarao; the 9 | n half is the open Straus-Subbarao/Fabrykowski-Subbarao question.
